prd: §4.1 MVP 범위 포함: 웹 상황판의 팀별 경로/구역/마커 시각화, OP별 경로 비교, 단말 최신성 표시
§5.1 시범 시나리오 5 수색 시작 및 GPS 기록
§5.1 시범 시나리오 11 인수인계 / 다음 투입 구역 판단
architecture: §1.2 상위 컴포넌트: Web 상황판 + MapLibre GL JS + SSE
context_refs.boundaries: spec/boundaries.md §3 S3-2, §9.1 Event Envelope, §9.2 Board Shell Slots, §10 Harness Mapping
harness: SC-03 사건 오프라인 패키지 사전 적재

included: 웹 상황판 route, layout, MapLibre root, shared state wiring
board shell slot registry와 slot mounting/final merge
board API assembly 및 board response DTO
SSE 수신 이벤트의 eventId dedupe, stale event 방어, board response convergence 처리
OP 비교 화면과 OP별 레이어 토글
오프라인 패키지 미완료 경고 badge slot
MarkerDetailPanel의 상황판 layout ownership. 실제 marker edit/delete mutation 실행은 S5 API 호출 경계로 위임

excluded.reason: S3-2는 상황판 shell/API assembly owner이며 source-of-truth domain write를 소유하지 않는다.

excluded.reason: S3-2는 S4 stream을 소비하고 refetch trigger 이후 API assembly 적용만 소유한다.

excluded.item: 자동 수색 누락 확정 또는 다음 구역 지시

fr_mapping.summary: 경로와 주요 변경사항을 상황판에 실시간 반영한다.
fr_mapping.handling: S4 SSE stream과 BoardAssembler를 소비해 path/marker/area/op/package/PolicePhone freshness slot을 수렴시킨다.

fr_mapping.summary: 지도 기준 범위와 수색 범위를 상황판에 표시한다.
fr_mapping.handling: S2 SearchAreaQuery와 SearchAreaQuery 결과를 read-only slot으로 렌더링한다.
SEARCH_AREA_CHANGED와 board response area row를 반영하되 구역 완료 write는 S2 소유로 둔다.
incident_assignment/search_area_assignment/team metadata를 board style registry에 매핑해 source row 변경 없이 표현 계층에서만 적용한다.

fr_mapping.summary: 최신 수색 현황의 기록 시각을 확인할 수 있게 표시한다.
fr_mapping.handling: search path record time, PolicePhone record status, lastHeartbeatAt/lastSyncAt 경과를 board API에 표시한다. OP/팀/마커/구간 필터는 FR-09 원의미가 아니라 display-only UX로만 둔다.

fr_mapping.summary: OP별 레이어를 선택하고 이전 OP와 현재 OP를 비교한다.
fr_mapping.handling: S8 OP/duty shift/handover, S3-1 path/segment, S5 marker source를 opId 기준으로 병합해 선택된 OP만 표시하고 source row는 변경하지 않는다.
S5 marker type 중 terrain/status 계열을 별도 layer style로 렌더링한다.

fr_mapping.summary: 분산된 수색 정보를 공용 상황판 한 화면에서 정리해 본다.
fr_mapping.handling: team/PolicePhone, path, area, marker, missing person, package, OP slots를 BoardAssembler에서 병합한다. toast slot은 FR-10/FR-17 및 알림 NFR의 표현 요소로만 취급한다.

fr_mapping.summary: 오프라인 지도 준비 상태를 상황판에서 확인한다.
fr_mapping.handling: S7 OfflinePackageInstallationQuery와 OFFLINE_PACKAGE_INSTALLATION_CHANGED를 package_badge slot으로 표시한다.

fr_mapping.summary: 자동 누락 확정이나 다음 구역 지시 없이 OP 경로·구역·마커 증거를 함께 보여준다.
fr_mapping.handling: S3-2는 path/area/marker/op slots를 병합해 사람이 판단할 근거를 렌더링하되 missing_area, recommended_area, auto_blindspot slot이나 CTA를 생성하지 않는다.
S1-2 PolicePhoneFreshnessQuery의 lastHeartbeatAt/lastSyncAt 경과를 normal/stale/lost와 elapsed label로 인코딩한다.
현재 세션 policePhoneId와 선택 policePhoneId를 기준으로 path slot style을 강조한다.
비핵심 overlay를 숨기는 board-level display preset을 제공한다.
overall_search_area, 최근 활동 위치, 기본 지역 순으로 viewport 대체 순서을 적용한다.
S3-1 path와 S1-2 PolicePhone type을 결합해 patrol car layer style을 분리한다.

fr_mapping.summary: 인수인계 메모를 OP·구역·경로 맥락과 함께 보여준다.

fr_mapping.handling: S8 SearchHistorySummaryQuery 결과를 search_history_summary slot에 표시하며 누락 확정·다음 구역 지시 문구를 차단한다.

provided.summary: 상황판 shell 초기 렌더와 SSE 복구용 source query assembly

sinceVersion.description: Optional previous boardResponseVersion reload watermark. GET /board still returns a full snapshot for the requested opIds/includeSlots and must not filter source-owner rows by this aggregate value. Owner-local minVersion/sinceVersion filters require a future per-slot or per-source cursor request shape.

geometry.description: Canonical source LineString; render simplification is display-only.

summaryText.description: Must not contain automatic missing-area confirmation, risk judgment, or next-area direction.

closedAt.description: null for OPEN/not_closed board responses; required non-null only when terminalStatus is CLOSED, PURGE_PENDING, or PURGED.

sourceVersions.description: Per slot arrays keyed by §9.2 slot name. Each row mirrors the slot row cursor so REST response id/status/version can be compared with SSE payload and board API row.

geometryHash.description: Hash of canonical source geometry rows. OP comparison and render simplification must not change this value.

sourceHashes.description: Per slot arrays keyed by §9.2 slot name. Hashes are row-level, not aggregate-only.

slotSources.description: Slot별 row-level source cursor. Aggregate-only sourceVersions/sourceHashes are insufficient; every slot row must be comparable by id/status/version/sequence/sourceSpec/sourceHash/latestEventId.

provided_by_s3_2.name: BoardAssembler.refetch(RefetchSignal)

notes: slot must be one of spec/boundaries.md §9.2.
id/status/version from the source write response and SSE payload must be preserved for the projected slot row.
sourceHash is the canonical row hash before any board display filtering or render simplification.

provided_by_s3_2.ownership: S3-2 owns API assembly application after the trigger, board API source query lookup, BoardDTO assembly, and rendering convergence.

consumed_from_s4.name: EventFanout refetch trigger orchestration
consumed_from_s4.overall_search_area: S4 owns SSE endpoint, Last-Event-ID replay, event_dispatch_job/sse_replay_event, and trigger orchestration. S3-2 must not publish or fan out events; it only applies RefetchSignal input after S4 orchestration.

consumed.usage: incident_terminal slot에서 종료 상태와 write disabled reason을 read-only로 표시한다.
종료 후 sanitized tombstone만 상황판에 표시한다.
police_phone_freshness slot에서 60초 이후 stale, 5분 이후 lost 상태를 계산한다.
path slot, OP 비교, 순찰차/도보/차량 구간 표시를 구성한다.

consumed.interface: GET /incidents/{incidentId}/events, BaseEvent envelope, SSE id line sequence, EventFanout refetch trigger orchestration
consumed.usage: S4가 RefetchSignal를 orchestrate한다. S3-2는 trigger 이후 BoardAssembler.refetch input을 받아 APPLIED|DUPLICATE|STALE|REFETCH_REQUIRED|FAILED_RETRYABLE 결과로 board response를 조립하거나 board response reload를 요구한다.
marker slot, marker detail panel, toast slot을 구성한다.
package_badge slot과 지도 base layer 상태 표시를 구성한다.
op_toggle, op_history, handover_memo, handover_status, search_history_summary slots를 구성한다.

events_subscribed.handler: incident shell entry와 base board API을 생성 또는 갱신한다.
incident_terminal slot을 활성화하고 실시간 위치·개인정보 slot을 sanitized 상태로 전환한다.
overall_search_area slot과 viewport 대체 순서 기준을 갱신한다.
area status/version을 갱신하되 자동 누락 판단을 생성하지 않는다.
운용 중 PolicePhone path 강조 기준을 갱신한다.
현재 세션 강조를 종료 상태로 전환한다.
path slot에 version/sequence가 더 최신인 경우만 반영한다.
marker slot과 detail panel source row를 갱신한다.
발견 marker 강조와 toast slot을 갱신한다.
active OP, op_toggle, op_history, comparison defaults를 갱신한다.

acceptance_criteria.given: S4 SSE stream sends duplicate PATH_APPENDED with the same eventId
acceptance_criteria.then: path row, toast row, map layer, and board_refetch_probe contain only one applied effect for that eventId

acceptance_criteria.given: board API already has entity version 5
acceptance_criteria.when: SSE delivers version 4 or lower sequence event
acceptance_criteria.then: refetch marks the event STALE and the visible board does not regress

acceptance_criteria.given: Last-Event-ID replay is too old or refetch detects an event gap
acceptance_criteria.when: S4 returns gone_refetch_required or cursor marks needs_board response_reload
acceptance_criteria.then: web reloads GET /board and converges to the latest board response without duplicate UI elements

acceptance_criteria.given: OP1 and OP2 have paths, markers, completed areas, handover memos, and search history summary
acceptance_criteria.then: selected OP, current OP, completed OP, original geometry hash, memo links, and summary source links are visible without domain writes; original geometry row and board API geometryHash remain unchanged before and after comparison

acceptance_criteria.given: PolicePhone heartbeat timestamps are recent, older than 60 seconds, and older than 5 minutes
acceptance_criteria.then: location dots show normal, stale, and lost states with elapsed-time labels and no separate alert

acceptance_criteria.given: S7 package installation includes READY, PARTIAL, STALE, and FAILED PolicePhones
acceptance_criteria.then: incomplete or stale PolicePhones are visible in team/PolicePhone list and map badge, while READY PolicePhones clear the warning

acceptance_criteria.given: incident_terminal slot indicates CLOSED/PURGE_PENDING/PURGED and PolicePhoneFreshnessQuery still has heartbeat/location rows.
acceptance_criteria.when: board API assembles closed incident tombstone.
acceptance_criteria.then: police_phone_freshness slot returns an empty row set or is not rendered, and the board does not show latest PolicePhone location, freshness dot, elapsed heartbeat label, or live-location style.

acceptance_criteria.given: current PolicePhone, patrol car path, foot path, and marker fixtures exist
acceptance_criteria.when: user toggles simple map mode and PolicePhone/path filters
acceptance_criteria.then: display style changes only in board state and source rows, outbox rows, and SSE events are unchanged

acceptance_criteria.given: SUPPORT_REQUEST_CREATED and PERSON_FOUND events arrive twice with the same eventId
acceptance_criteria.then: each alert is shown once and links back to the matching marker row

acceptance_criteria.given: incident is closed and terminal/tombstone board response is available
acceptance_criteria.when: user opens the board or receives INCIDENT_CLOSED
acceptance_criteria.then: incident_terminal slot exposes only incidentId, terminalStatus/closedStatus, closedAt, writeDisabledReason, and localPurgeState with id/status/version/sequence/sourceSpec/sourceHash/latestEventId; realtime location, missing person PII, package reload, and stream resubscribe controls are absent
each slot row validates id/status/version/sequence/sourceSpec/sourceHash/latestEventId and slotSources/sourceVersions/sourceHashes provide row-level comparison data, not aggregate-only values

acceptance_criteria.given: REST source write response and SSE payload contain the same id/status/version for a source row
acceptance_criteria.then: S3-2 stores APPLIED only for the matching slot/sourceSpec/entityId/status/version/sequence/sourceHash and a stale event cannot overwrite another slot or source row

acceptance_criteria.given: search history summary text or OP comparison UI state proposes missing-area confirmation, risk judgment, next-area direction, or source mutation
acceptance_criteria.when: board assembles search_history_summary or applies OP comparison filters
acceptance_criteria.then: forbidden search history summary text is blocked and OP comparison filters remain display-only without changing source geometry/status/version

edge_cases: SSE reconnect receives out-of-order events across different slots
board response fetch succeeds but one source slot fixture is temporarily unavailable
OP comparison includes a closed OP with purged location-sensitive fields
package_badge event arrives before package installation query is refreshed
heartbeat continues after incident close but board must not show fresh location for closed incident
MapLibre style loads but tile endpoint returns tile_unavailable
search history summary is unavailable while handover memo and OP comparison remain usable

error_handling.gone_refetch_required: Show transient reconnect state, refetch board API, clear event replay buffer after convergence.
error_handling.team_not_assigned: Render access-denied shell without OP/path/marker/memo details.
error_handling.channel_not_allowed: Block non-web board API access and return API error without rendering source data.
error_handling.tile_unavailable: Keep operational overlays visible where possible and show map base layer unavailable state with retry.
error_handling.summary_unavailable: Keep OP comparison and handover memo visible; show search history summary retry affordance owned by S8 action.
error_handling.stale_event: Return STALE in the board refetch result and keep current slot state unchanged.
error_handling.duplicate_event: Return DUPLICATE in the board refetch result and do not create duplicate row or UI element.

performance: GET /board p95 target is under 2 seconds for harness fixture size.
SSE event application should update the visible slot within 3 seconds in online harness.
OP comparison toggles must not refetch unchanged domain rows when board API already contains selected OP data.
security: Board board response requires web channel, incident access, and location access recording for location-bearing slots.
Closed incident board response must expose only sanitized terminal/tombstone fields allowed by S1-1/S1-3.
S3-2 must not expose internal incident_data_purge, location_data_access_audit, event_dispatch_job, or marker_notification internals.
observability: Expose refetch metrics for applied, duplicate, stale, failed, and board response_required event counts.
Log board response convergence failures with incidentId, lastEventId, boardResponseVersion, and reloadReason.
Expose board API latency and slot assembly latency per slot.

backend.name: board_api_rejects_unassigned_account

backend.name: board_schema_rejects_unknown_slot

web.scenario: SC-11 search history summary fixture containing missing-area confirmation, risk judgment, or next-area direction is blocked while OP comparison remains usable.

web.name: police_phone_freshness_renders_normal_stale_lost
